params.goal: Create an executive-level Company Dossier page for the user's company.

Create an executive-level company KPIs and internal KPIs, all the KPI metric not necesserly need to be available, some KPI metric will be estimated based on industry standards and company profile. This has two goals, one to assess compnay health and performance from diffrent perspectives, second is to create an executive-level company KPIs and internal KPIs presentation, that company should be looking to improve its operations. For example, burn-rate if it's startup company or similar. It should also have main title as 'Executive Company KPIs and Internal KPIs' and should not have any hero section, only metrics section for internal and external KPIs and Make sure YOU ALWAYS OUTPUT recomendation as bullet points AND last bit include this text as well make note that ALL figures are not representavite just acts as placeholder for actual figures or estimation.

Create an executive-level company Analytics dashboard with various MUI charts only should have 4-8 charts. Data doesn't need to real, just need to relevant to company.  YOU ALWAYS OUTPUT summary as bullet points AND last bit include this text as well make note that ALL figures are not representavite just acts as placeholder for actual figures or estimation.

Search the web and create an executive-level dashboard tailored strictly to the user's industry and company type (e.g., startups). Structure the dashboard into distinct, separate sections: 1) 'Industry News & Updates' (covering recent news, press releases, and announcements, including publication dates) and 2) 'Upcoming Events & Conferences' (covering relevant industry conferences, summits, and meetups, including event dates). Curate 10 to 20 total credible links/sources across these sections. ALWAYS OUTPUT summaries under each section as bullet points, clearly including the date and source alongside each headline/event. ONLY USE DATA FROM CREDIBLE NEWS SITES, OFFICIAL EVENT PAGES, AND PRESS RELEASES. HERO IS NOT NEEDED. At the very end, include the note: 'All figures are placeholders/estimations and are not representative of actual figures.'
Bootstrap company knowledge base and scrape documentation. Also search how company solution compare to competitors.
